pm_confidence_score.interpretation: PM confidence score is 62.0 because four HIGH-risk assumptions (Workday API, Azure AD permissions, e-signature compliance, data retention policy) are unconfirmed, critical resource R6 has zero slack and no backup, QA allocation violates PMBOK 8.2 baseline by 25%, and Hybrid SDLC requires active Product Owner engagement during Phase 2-3 sprints. Mitigation: confirm all four assumptions in writing before Phase 2 begins (T3), identify backup PM and Backend Developer, increase QA allocation to 129 hours (25% of dev effort), and name Product Owner for sprint prioritization.

project_viability.analysis: Critical path duration is 130 days (26 weeks × 5 days = 130 days). Deadline is 2026-06-30 (approximately 26 weeks from project start ~2025-12-30). Critical path duration equals deadline (130 days = 26 weeks). However, 15% buffer is applied in project_plan, reducing effective critical path to 110.5 days (130 × 0.85). Effective critical path 110.5 days < deadline 130 days (ratio 0.85 = 85% of deadline). Project is VIABLE on schedule IF buffer holds. However, R1, R2, R4, R5, R7 all flag integration and compliance risks that could consume buffer. If any integration risk materializes (Workday API unavailable, Azure AD permissions denied, e-signature vendor non-compliant, data retention policy undefined), buffer is consumed and project slips past deadline. Viability status: AT_RISK (critical path 85% of deadline, multiple integration risks unconfirmed).
